one_line: Exploratory questionnaire case study of barriers to and drivers for energy management in 14 non-energy-intensive Swedish manufacturing SMEs (engineering/metalworking, vehicle, food, plastics); continuous-flow sectors like pulp & paper, steel, cement, chemicals and aluminium appear only as comparison references and as sectors the studied firms explicitly do NOT belong to.
